name: HTML preview in mobile
description:
The task was to fix the mobile preview behaviour in `src/components/HTMLPreview.vue`, which previously always opened at desktop presets (`laptop` 1024×768 inline, `custom` 1200×800 popup) and overflowed phone viewports.

I added a `Device (auto)` size preset that resolves from `window.innerWidth`/`innerHeight` and orientation — phone (375×667 / 667×375), tablet (768×1024 / 1024×768), or desktop (1024×768 / 1440×900).

Resolved device sizes are clamped to the real available space (container box inline, viewport in the popup) so the frame always fits instead of forcing horizontal scroll.

Viewport state (`viewportWidth/Height/isMobile`) is tracked in `data` and refreshed on `resize` + `orientationchange`, re-applying sizes to the inline frame and open popup so portrait↔landscape rotation is respected; mobile defaults to `device` while desktop keeps `laptop`.

Mobile popups also disable drag/resize and hide the redundant size selector, and a side-bug was fixed: the generated iframe document's CSS was missing all semicolons, so the entire `body` rule had been dropped by the parser (now restored, plus mobile-safe `max-width`/`overflow-wrap`/`text-size-adjust` rules).

messages.content: Fix how preview opens in mobile, make sure it opens in mobile size and landsapce o r portrait depending on the device.
